text_block_list.text:
—The Japan Cup.
Rice Shower didn't just train—

Great effort was also poured into the prior video production
in order to project the aura of 'the strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Emergency alert! Emergency alert!
A swarm of formidable foreign Umamusume
are invading Japan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Japan's top Umamusume are... almost all recuperating, there's no one left!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Who's going to stand up? Who will it be...?
If it's come to this...!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I just have to awaken!
I won't let anyone call me a mediocre Umamusume ever again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do it too~
Ei, ei, mun♪"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a movie trailer-style PV? Never heard of it.
Still, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I'm in top shape before taking it on.
Be sure to watch me closely, okay!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, coming soon!!
You will meet a Royce you never knew.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...What's this? Official?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no way this is official merch.
I'm pretty sure Royce-chan made it herself.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you really go all out every single time.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Royce's races are just so memorable, you know?
She always makes things super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That builds the hype perfectly.
It makes up for the disappointment of missing the star player.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now, as long as Nature-san, Tannhauser-san, and I can run our absolute best race...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Bwehhh, Royce-chan.
Blood's all of a sudden gushing from my snoot~.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Bu-hyo-hyo~?! Wait, a scratch?!
Can't be helped, we need something extra to hype things up!
Running around giving it everything until the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
How was my time, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I tried running the same distance counterclockwise to simulate the real race, but...
choice_data_list: Perfect! These conditions are a perfect match!
Perfect! These conditions are a perfect match!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Yes, Ticket-san isn't the only one suited best for Tokyo 2400m.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"In this race, I'll make everyone acknowledge it.
That I, too, am the 'strongest'!"
And on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
By some miracle, we made it in time~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, Royce-chan is working so hard, too...
I've got to find a way into this festival somehow...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
Are we not in the festival mood... after all?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we do this, Royce?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Two years ago, Teio made history in this Japan Cup too.
Who will win today and forge a brand-new legend?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Nature-san.
But victory isn't the only thing we're competing for today.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let me make this perfectly clear.
Something just as important as victory is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's all about how much praise you can earn from the racing fans!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Royce...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how pathetic it sounds,
I just... I want to...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: On this grand stage—I want to be acknowledged!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be called amazing! Absolutely!
I want to be revered like a luxury car.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Praised, and praised,
and praised and praised and praised,
I wanna blow the sky away with cheers of 'Royce-chan!'

A murmur runs through the venue.
Those were straightforward words
she had never spoken before.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
True, it may be an ambition beyond my station.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Know yourself! Think day and night! Try everything!
If you express yourself to the absolute fullest, you can reach it!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: To becoming the "strongest" in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That is what I've been pursuing all this time.
Together with you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Today is the final touch! With popular contenders
like Nature-san and Tannhauser-san as our opponents,
it couldn't be more perfect!
(UWAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Royce... I see. You've worried, wandered, and found your own answers, haven't you?
But still...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving up the spotlight! I'm the one who's gonna win today!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, here I go, Nature-san!

――"The Strongest."
A title bestowed upon an Umamusume
who has seized countless GⅠ victories. But...

As long as you don't give up, there's always a way for anyone.
Now, I'll aim for a color unseen in history, unique only to me.
